Mountain Report

  • Webcams
  • Trail Maps
  • Uphill
  • Safety

Opening Day is November 26th

Operating Hours: 9:00 am – 4:00 pm

Happy Thanksgiving and welcome back for the start of Sun Valley’s 91st winter season! On today’s menu: a steamy mug of delicious hot cocoa (in a commemorative 91st season Opening Day mug) followed by some tasty top-to-mid-mountain skiing and riding on Bald Mountain. Don’t wait for leftovers. Join us for a day of family fun. Remember, you can’t ski or ride every day this season if you don’t start today!

The weather forecast for the valley floor calls for a mostly sunny day, with a high near 45. Calm wind becoming east southeast around 6 mph in the afternoon.

Lifts open at 9 a.m. with The Roundhouse Gondola and the new Christmas Lift running and Upper College and Roundhouse Lane open for skiing and riding. New terrian may open today as conditions permit. Lower River Run will remain closed to allow for additional snowmaking, and skiers and riders will download on the Gondola at the end of the day.

River Run Ticket Windows are open daily 9am–4pm for 2026–2027 Season Pass pick-up.

Black Friday 3-Pack: Unlock three days of skiing or riding, all for $399! Valid for any three days on Bald or Dollar Mountain during the 2026–2027 season, excluding blackout dates. Offer ends December 1! Buy Now >

Bald Mountain Closures:

Construction crews are working across the mountain to finalize the Lookout & Christmas Lift Projects and get ready for winter.

Bald Mountain and Dollar Mountain are closed to all uphill travel. Uphill access will remain closed until further notice, as snowmaking, grooming, and lift construction work continues. Thank you for respecting all posted closures.

Last Updated Nov 26, 5:51 AM MT
